decisions: DECISIONS V-1 and H-1 and the rulings after lane INPUT and after H1PLAN (main, under Layth's 5 Nov 2026 delegation): one factor at a time against the default; k21 and k25 are left out (ruling M-2 after REGAUDIT: register section 13 G2 stands until Layth lifts it by name); cohort arms pair by common_outer_test_set_balanced; the group draw groups genomes by BV-BRC MLST sequence type; the selection seed 1 and the log-loss margin 0.02 (descriptive only, it decides nothing) are decided values. pool_budget.reason: main's rulings on REVIEW-INPUT4 to REVIEW-INPUT7 (M1, L4): before anything is counted, refuse a comparison whose still-unwritten ksets (the pool and every data root), matrices (10% of a root's ksets), arm outputs (5% of the roots' ksets), the pool's curated/ copy (measured) and WORK-level files (64 MiB) would take more than 80% of the free disk. The per-genome size is the mean of the species' own counted ksets in RAW, else 27.5 MiB (REVIEW-INPUT4's Salmonella estimate). The kset size, the 10%, the 5% and the 64 MiB are stated figures until H-1 measures real per-species ksets and matrices. H-1 (DECISIONS D2 after H1PLAN): default_kset_bytes is revision 12's measured kset size for salmonella_enterica, 29,147,870 B per genome: stage R10's kset total of 58,295,739,196 B (its guard's max_ksets) over its 2,000 genomes, rounded up
